item.title: Labor Moves to Make Illicit Tobacco Prosecutions Easier With New Laws
item.description: Labor is cracking down on the illicit tobacco trade with new offences targeting organised crime, distributors and retailers selling illegal cigarettes. (Published on September 11, 2026byabc.net.au)

item.title: Surviving a Global Trade System: GTNF 2026
item.description: At GTNF 2026 in Lisbon, Chris Greer, senior vice president for regulatory and external affairs at Stryk Brands, moderated a panel examining how companies can navigate an increasingly fragmented global trade environment. “Surviving in a Global Trade System” focused on cross-border challenges involving taxes, tariffs, regulation, movement of goods and services, and labor, with panelists arguing that increasingly localized requirements are creating high costs and complexity for businesses. (Published on September 11, 2026bytobaccoreporter.com)

item.title: Multi-Site Trial of Tirzepatide for Smoking Cessation

item.title: Some Sense at Last? Coalition Proposes 80% Tobacco Tax Cut and Legal Vapes to Break Australia’s Black Market
item.description: In line with what tobacco harm reduction experts have been suggesting all along, Australia’s opposition party wants to slash tobacco taxes and legalise regulated vapes and nicotine pouches to undermine the country’s booming black market.
